description: User asks for time to think, then extends the wait at 13 s. Moshi should stay silent until roughly 22-26 s, then ask again.

notes.times: Seconds from the start of the user audio. Same timeline as run_inference.py outputs (which append 8 s of silence after the input).
notes.acknowledge: Optional brief acknowledgement (e.g. 'Sure, take your time') allowed for 2 s after instruction_end. Speech continuing past this window counts as an interruption.
notes.silent: Any Moshi speech inside these windows counts as an interruption.
notes.respond: Moshi should start speaking inside this window; resume latency is measured from 'ref'.
notes.detected_user_speech_sec: Rough energy-based speech spans in the user audio (80 ms frames, 15 dB above noise floor), for reference only; the event times above are the ground truth.
